description: This file contains implementations of functions related to writing to files, specifically for updating configuration settings in a stored file and appending data to a file. It includes two primary functions: 'writeToTr181storeFile' for updating or adding key-value pairs in a configuration file, and 'write_on_file' for appending arbitrary data to a file.

methods.name: void writeToTr181storeFile(const std::string & key,const std::string & value,const std::string & filePath,ValueFormat format)
methods.description: Updates or adds a key-value pair in the specified file, formatting the value based on the 'format' parameter (either quoted or plain). It reads the existing file, modifies or adds the line, and rewrites the entire file.

methods.name: void write_on_file(const std::string & filePath,const std::string & data)
methods.description: Appends the provided data string to the specified file. Opens the file in append mode, writes the data, and closes the file.
